problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 16 infrastructure projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score 0.148, impact factor 0.132, allocation limits [0.085, 0.469]  
* Project B: benefit score 0.196, impact factor 0.102, allocation limits [0.032, 0.750]  
* Project C: benefit score 0.173, impact factor 0.028, allocation limits [0.056, 0.700]  
* Project D: benefit score 0.153, impact factor 0.269, allocation limits [0.078, 0.377]  
* Project E: benefit score 0.127, impact factor 0.131, allocation limits [0.061, 0.420]  
* Project F: benefit score 0.120, impact factor 0.147, allocation limits [0.012, 0.663]  
* Project G: benefit score 0.072, impact factor 0.153, allocation limits [0.027, 0.361]  
* Project H: benefit score 0.108, impact factor 0.282, allocation limits [0.066, 0.550]  
* Project I: benefit score 0.107, impact factor 0.111, allocation limits [0.089, 0.896]  
* Project J: benefit score 0.126, impact factor 0.212, allocation limits [0.078, 0.482]  
* Project K: benefit score 0.130, impact factor 0.016, allocation limits [0.063, 0.426]  
* Project L: benefit score 0.142, impact factor 0.094, allocation limits [0.068, 0.328]  
* Project M: benefit score 0.167, impact factor 0.066, allocation limits [0.074, 0.311]  
* Project N: benefit score 0.108, impact factor 0.110, allocation limits [0.074, 0.829]  
* Project O: benefit score 0.149, impact factor 0.077, allocation limits [0.079, 0.514]  
* Project P: benefit score 0.115, impact factor 0.074, allocation limits [0.058, 0.395]  

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified limits, and the total allocation across all projects must equal the entire budget.  
To ensure adequate coverage, the set of high-priority projects L = {B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, M, N, O, P} must collectively receive at least 0.847 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the overall impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.176, and the total benefit score must be at least 0.117.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
